test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the pre-historic site called Daimabad located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daimabad is a Chalcolithic or copper age site (2200-1000 BCE) **on the left bank of the Pravara, a tributary of the Godavari in present-day Maharashtra's Ahmednagar district.
 
• Archaeologist BP Bopardikar found the site in 1956, and it was explored three times over the next two decades 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Discoveries at Daimabad indicate that **Late Harappan civilisation s**pread into India's Deccan Plateau.
 
• Daimabad is well-known for the discovery of** several bronze artefacts,** some of which were inspired by the Harappan civilisation.
